title: Where Scientific Search Agents Fail: Decision-Checkpoint Auditing of Exposure and Inspection Attempts
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce decision checkpoints that record observations and tool actions without benchmark labels during inference, then join target identities and evaluator labels to assign outcome categories from recorded events.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Across five conditions on 540 answerable AutoResearchBench Deep questions in a fixed, target-enriched environment, keyword search achieves 24.6\% accuracy, compared with 17.8\% for raw search.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a scientific-search agent failed to encounter a target paper, attempt to inspect it, or return an accepted answer after inspection.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
